# KayKit - Adventurers

Author: Kay Lousberg
License: CC0
Source: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers

Local downloaded version: Adventurers 2.0 FREE. Original License.txt retained.
Phase 25 uses Characters/fbx/Barbarian.fbx, its texture/material dependencies,
and Assets/fbx/sword_1handed.fbx as the Armorer's inspection prop. The supplied
Rig_Medium_General Idle_A clip was sampled through Unity for the passive pose.
The bear hat is hidden on the scene instance; source models are unchanged.

Asset audit: sword_2handed_color has the same geometry as sword_2handed;
bow_withString adds string fittings to the same bow design. Neither is accepted
as a distinct Tier I weapon. Warrior and Archer Tier I meshes remain blocked.
Full pack retained temporarily until manual QA and dependency-based pruning.
